name: cx-timeline
description: CX Timeline — hosted interactive timeline & commissioning planner

scripts.test: node tools/smoke.js && node tools/smoke_folder.js && node tools/smoke_desktop.js && node tools/smoke_hosted.js && node tools/test_sql.js
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run build:desktop && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build

cxTimeline._comment: deployment: 'hosted' saves to Supabase and requires a backend at build time; 'folder' publishes with no backend at all and keeps the plan in a folder the user picks. tools/dist.js reads this, so the shape of a deployment is decided here, in the repository, rather than in a CI setting nobody can see. updateChannel: the deployment an installed desktop copy follows for updates — blank means an installed copy never updates itself.
